name: Unidirectional Spectral Tracking
definition: A spectral volume rendering technique that samples events (absorption, scattering, null) using a majorant density and returns the path length and spectral contribution, handling Russian roulette implicitly via event selection.
summary: Unidirectional Spectral Tracking is a spectral volume rendering technique that samples absorption, scattering, and null events using a majorant density to drive the sampling process, returning the path length and spectral contribution while handling Russian roulette implicitly via event selection.
